annotations.title: Describe a look of their own

description: Puts the art style of a picture the person uploaded (one of their own looks, from story_looks) into words, so every picture of a story can be drawn in it. Without description it shows you the picture; look at it and call again with name, description and base. Free.

base.description: The built-in look whose captions, texture and colours suit it best

description.description: The style in 60 to 120 words, as instructions to an illustrator: the medium, how lines and edges are made, the shading, the palette by colour names, the light, the texture and grain, the detail and how figures are stylised, the mood. Never what the picture shows, never an artist, studio, franchise or artwork name

name.description: Two to four plain words for its tile, e.g. "Grainy blue linocut"; no artist, studio or franchise names

no_style.description: true when the picture has no style to copy (a screenshot, a document, a chart, a photo of text): it's taken out of their looks
